summary: Tested Stripe payment integration (checkout/status) and SSR for /shop and /shop/[category]. 10/11 pytest tests pass. End-to-end UI flow verified: Buy Now → modal → /api/payments/checkout → redirect to checkout.stripe.com works. Server-side price validation correctly ignores spoofed `price` field. SSR for /shop returns 20 product cards in initial HTML (verified with curl), /shop/wall-art returns 3 (category-scoped). Only intermittent issue: Emergent Stripe proxy occasionally returns 'No such checkout.session' on retrieve immediately after create (proxy-level flakiness, not app code).

minor.issue: Intermittently returns 'No such checkout.session' immediately after create (~30-60% failure rate in burst tests). Direct curl against https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1/checkout/sessions/{sid} also fails for the same SIDs, confirming this is an Emergent Stripe proxy issue, not application code. Sessions that DO resolve return correct status/payment_status/amount_total/currency. Suggest adding client-side retry-with-backoff on /checkout/success polling.

action_items: Optional: Add client-side polling retry/backoff on /checkout/success page since Emergent Stripe proxy occasionally returns 'No such checkout.session' on first retrieve.
Optional: Persist a 'fallback amount_total' in payment_transactions row (already done) and read from DB if Stripe retrieve transiently fails so UI doesn't error.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/lib/stripe.js correctly routes via Emergent proxy when STRIPE_API_KEY contains 'sk_test_emergent' — clean implementation using fetch + form-encoded bodies.

/app/app/api/payments/checkout/route.js — Server-side price validation is correct: it ignores any 'price' field from the client and fetches price from Supabase products table. Verified by sending price=0.01 with qty=2; Stripe session amount_total came back as 15998 cents ($79.99 × 2).
/app/app/api/payments/status route does idempotent order creation only on first 'paid' transition — good pattern.
ProductDetail modal collects only name+email (correct — Stripe collects shipping/card on hosted page).

SSR: /app/lib/shop.js + /app/app/(routes)/shop/page.js + /shop/[category]/page.js correctly fetch from Supabase server-side and pass initial props. Curl confirms product cards + names + prices are in initial HTML (not JS-rendered).

success_rate.backend: 91% (10/11 pytest cases, 1 flaky due to proxy)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (Buy Now → modal → checkout API → Stripe redirect verified end-to-end)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Stripe live integration via Emergent proxy verified working end-to-end. The only flaky surface is the proxy's checkout.sessions.retrieve immediately after create — direct curl to https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1/checkout/sessions/{sid} reproduces the same intermittent 'No such checkout.session' error, confirming it is not an app bug. SSR for /shop returns 20 product cards in initial HTML, /shop/wall-art returns 3 (correctly filtered). Buy Now → payment-modal → /api/payments/checkout → redirect to checkout.stripe.com all wire up correctly. data-testids used: buy-now-button, payment-modal, payment-name-input, payment-email-input, pay-now-button, payment-error, product-card-{slug}.
rca of the issue: Status retrieve flakiness RCA: created 5+ sessions back-to-back via /api/payments/checkout; on each, immediately called GET /api/payments/status/{sid}. ~30-60% of calls returned 'No such checkout.session'. Bypassed our app and called the proxy directly (curl https://integrations.emergentagent.com/stripe/v1/checkout/sessions/{sid} -u sk_test_emergent:) for the same SIDs — got the identical 'No such checkout.session' error. Conclusion: Emergent Stripe proxy occasionally fails to find a freshly-created session on retrieve, likely due to internal account routing/load balancing not being read-after-write consistent. Mitigation in app code: add retry with exponential backoff (e.g., 1s/2s/4s) on /checkout/success page polling, OR fall back to payment_transactions row from Supabase when Stripe retrieve transiently 404s.
